title: Stan Hansen challenges Inoki’s supremacy
summary: Stan Hansen’s power and lariat threaten the champion at the center of New Japan. A championship upset forces Inoki into a rematch to restore his position.

chapters.title: Hansen takes the NWF championship
chapters.result: Hansen defeats Inoki by count-out to win the NWF title.
chapters.context: A rare title loss gives the challenger a concrete claim over New Japan’s standard-bearer.

chapters.title: Inoki wins the rematch
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Hansen to regain the championship.
chapters.context: The champion answers Hansen’s physical threat with a decisive title recovery in Tokyo.
